show.description: A rising superstar is forced to officiate her own mother’s wedding only to discover the groom is the powerful man who once tried to control her career and her life. Trapped in a billionaire’s mansion as his new stepdaughter, Shreya must protect her mother from a charming predator who wants them both, and will destroy everything to keep them.
